name: release-manager
title: Release Manager
description: Plan, track, and communicate product releases in YouTrack. A project tab lists release versions with planned issues, progress bars, feature freeze, release notes, and an audit trail. A Release Calendar dashboard widget shows freeze and release dates across projects. Release Managers and Light Release Managers get different rights. Two optional workflows sync releases with a custom field or attach issues by a search filter.
changeNotes:
Version 1.4.1

  • Security: The server checks the Release Manager and Light Release Manager roles for every change to releases, issue statuses, and app settings
  • Security: The release field sync changes only issues of the current project and only the mapped release field
  • Security: Issue data is returned only for issues that the current user can read
  • Fix: The Release Calendar checks Release Manager group membership on every request
  • Fix: A save based on an old copy of a release is rejected, so it does not overwrite changes made by workflows or other users
  • Fix: Sync now and save no longer reload the whole release list; expanded releases stay open
  • Improvement: Each release keeps the 200 most recent audit events

Version 1.4.0

  • Feature: Auto-attach by filter — give a release a YouTrack search query, and issues in the project that match it are added to Planned Issues automatically. Issues that stop matching are removed; issues added by hand are never removed. Includes a match preview with a link to the same search in YouTrack, a Sync now action, an “A” marker on auto-attached issues, and audit events. Enable it with the ‘Feature: Auto-attach by Filter’ setting and the ‘Auto-attach Issues by Filter’ workflow; it works only when Custom Field Sync is off
  • Improvement: Planned Issues in the release form is one section with an Issue IDs | Auto-attach filter switch
  • Improvement: Save and sync errors now show the server’s message instead of a generic one
  • Fix: Planned issue lists in the release form and on the release card keep their columns aligned
  • Fix: Release Calendar “Today” no longer uses a stale date, and calendar controls work with the keyboard
  • Requirement: YouTrack 2026.2 or later

Version 1.3.0

  • Feature: Release Calendar dashboard widget — visualize release and feature freeze dates across multiple projects on a single calendar view (month, quarter, and year views)
  • Fix: Resolve localised custom field bundle field name mismatch that caused version select to fail syncing release and start dates in non-English YouTrack instances
  • Improvement: Redesigned welcome page with interactive onboarding step cards — step 1 auto-completes when the app is configured, step 2 is gated until configuration is done, and the header settings icon is hidden during onboarding to reduce noise

Version 1.2.3

  • Fix: Version field date/released-flag sync now works for all projects regardless of project ID format or bundle type (global vs independent copy)
  • Fix: Bundle element lookup no longer silently truncates at ~42 elements — uses explicit $top=1000
  • Fix: Sync logs now appear in the YouTrack App Technical Log instead of the browser console

Version 1.2.2

  • Fix: Sync release date and start date to version custom field bundle value when creating or editing a release
  • Fix: Sync Released flag to version custom field when marking a release as Released or reverting
  • Fix: Released and Archived columns now show correctly in the import versions table
  • Fix: Start date (feature freeze date) included in import and export to version custom fields
  • Fix: Planned issues’ custom field values are cleared when a release version is deleted

Version 1.2.1

  • Fix: Updated widget extension point to PROJECT_TAB for correct placement in YouTrack

Version 1.2.0

  • Feature: Allow using multi-select custom fields in mapping
  • Feature: Import custom field values as releases into the app
